Specification: This specification models a simple producer-consumer style system with two state variables: a set S representing stored produced items and a Boolean flag empty indicating whether the storage is empty. The initial state sets S to the empty set and empty to TRUE. The Produce action makes the system non-empty and adds one chosen subset of a fixed finite alphabet to S, while the Consume action is enabled only when the system is not empty and replaces S with an arbitrary subset of its current contents, updating empty to reflect whether the resulting set is empty; the file defines Init, Produce, Consume, and Next but does not include a full temporal specification or fairness conditions.
